segments.source: setOutputSettings(_:for:)
**Framework**: AVFoundation **Kind**: method
Sets the options the output uses to encode media from the given connection while recording.
segments.ko: 지정된 연결에서 녹화 중 미디어 인코딩에 사용하는 출력 옵션을 설정합니다.

segments.source: **Availability**:
iPadOS 10.0+
Mac Catalyst 14.0+
macOS 10.7+
tvOS 17.0+
Declaration
Discussion
For details on output settings, see [`Video settings`](video-settings.md) for video connections and [`Audio settings`](audio-settings.md) for audio connections.
segments.ko: For details on output settings, see [`Video settings`](video-settings.md) for video connections and [`Audio settings`](audio-settings.md) for audio connections.

segments.source: On iOS, your output settings dictionary may only contain keys listed returned from the [`supportedOutputSettingsKeys(for:)`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/supportedoutputsettingskeys(for:).md) method.
segments.ko: On iOS, your output settings dictionary may only contain keys listed returned from the [`supportedOutputSettingsKeys(for:)`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/supportedoutputsettingskeys(for:).md) method.

segments.source: If you specify any other key, the system throws an invalid argument exception.
segments.ko: If you specify any other key, the system throws an invalid argument exception.

segments.source: Additionally, the value you specify for [`AVVideoCodecKey`](avvideocodeckey.md) should be present in the [`availableVideoCodecTypes`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/availablevideocodectypes.md) array.
segments.ko: Additionally, the value you specify for [`AVVideoCodecKey`](avvideocodeckey.md) should be present in the [`availableVideoCodecTypes`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/availablevideocodectypes.md) array.

segments.source: If you specify [`AVVideoCompressionPropertiesKey`](avvideocompressionpropertieskey.md), you must also specify a valid value for [`AVVideoCodecKey`](avvideocodeckey.md).
segments.ko: [`AVVideoCompressionPropertiesKey`](avvideocompressionpropertieskey.md)를 지정하는 경우 [`AVVideoCodecKey`](avvideocodeckey.md)에 대한 유효한 값도 함께 지정해야 합니다.

segments.source: On iOS, the [`outputSettings(for:)`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/outputsettings(for:).md) method always provides a fully populated dictionary.
segments.ko: iOS에서 [`outputSettings(for:)`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/outputsettings(for:).md) 메서드는 항상 모든 항목이 채워진 딕셔너리를 제공합니다.

segments.source: If you call [`outputSettings(for:)`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/outputsettings(for:).md) with the intent of overriding a few of the values, you must exclude keys that aren’t supported before calling [`setOutputSettings(_:for:)`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/setoutputsettings(_:for:).md).
segments.ko: [`outputSettings(for:)`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/outputsettings(for:).md)를 호출해 일부 값만 재정의하려는 경우, [`setOutputSettings(_:for:)`](avcapturemoviefileoutput/setoutputsettings(_:for:).md)를 호출하기 전에 지원되지 않는 키를 제외해야 합니다.

segments.source: When providing an [`AVVideoCompressionPropertiesKey`](avvideocompressionpropertieskey.md) sub dictionary, you may specify a sparse dictionary.
segments.ko: [`AVVideoCompressionPropertiesKey`](avvideocompressionpropertieskey.md) 하위 딕셔너리를 제공할 때는 필요한 항목만 포함된 희소 딕셔너리를 지정할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: A movie file output object always fills in missing keys with default values for the current capture session configuration.
segments.ko: movie file output 객체는 현재 캡처 세션 구성의 기본값으로 누락된 키를 항상 채웁니다.

segments.source: Parameters

`outputSettings`: A dictionary of output settings. Pass an empty dictionary to specify that the format of the media from the connection shouldn’t change before writing to the file. Pass `nil` to specify that the session preset determines output format.
segments.ko: `outputSettings`: 출력 설정의 딕셔너리입니다. 파일에 쓰기 전에 연결에서 전달되는 미디어 형식이 변경되지 않도록 하려면 빈 딕셔너리를 전달합니다. 세션 프리셋이 출력 형식을 결정하도록 하려면 `nil`을 전달합니다.

segments.source: `connection`: The connection delivering the media to encode.
See Also

Returns a list of supported keys to use in the output settings dictionary.
segments.ko: 출력 설정 딕셔너리에 사용할 수 있는 지원 키 목록을 반환합니다.

segments.source: [func outputSettings(for: AVCaptureConnection) -> [String : Any]](avcapturemoviefileoutput/outputsettings(for:).md)
Returns the settings the output uses to encode media from the specified connection.
segments.ko: 지정한 연결의 미디어를 인코딩할 때 출력에서 사용하는 설정을 반환합니다.

segments.source: [var availableVideoCodecTypes: [AVVideoCodecType]](avcapturemoviefileoutput/availablevideocodectypes.md)
The video codecs types the output supports for recording movie files.
segments.ko: 출력이 movie file을 녹화할 때 지원하는 비디오 코덱 유형입니다.
